event_info.event_description: Analyze for disclosures on global pandemic risks. Look for corporate language discussing widespread impacts like supply chain disruptions, labor shortages, remote work transitions, and fundamental shifts in consumer demand.

holistic_analysis: AKAM’s 2024 Form 10-K references COVID-19 chiefly as a catalyst for abrupt swings in traffic and revenue rather than an acute operational threat that is still unfolding. Management recounts the surge in delivery-solution demand during the 2020 stay-at-home period, followed by a measurable decline once restrictions were lifted. These passages demonstrate that pandemic dynamics can materially swing revenue—first upward, then downward—highlighting sensitivity to widespread behavioural shifts. Elsewhere, the filing keeps the discussion forward-looking but generic, noting that future pandemics or related public-health crises could again disrupt operations. No quantified current-year losses, supply-chain shortages, or labour unavailability are disclosed, suggesting COVID-19 has migrated from an immediate crisis to a residual, scenario-based risk. Because the pandemic’s onset is nearly four years old relative to the February 2024 filing date, the Time Decay Principle places the evidentiary ceiling in the mid-range. The cited sentences therefore merit moderate scores (4-5), reflecting proven materiality yet diminished immediacy.

evidence_list.snippet: For example, revenue from our delivery solutions increased significantly in 2020 due in large part to greater consumption of online media and games during the onset of the COVID-19 pandemic and the associated stay-at-home orders across the globe.

components.reason: Explicitly attributes a material change in revenue to the COVID-19 pandemic (‘increased significantly… due in large part to’).
Indicates magnitude (‘increased significantly’) even though not numerically quantified.
Event occurred almost four years ago, so Time Decay reduces relevance.

evidence_list.reasoning_summary: Direct link between pandemic and material revenue swing earns a solid score, tempered by the historical nature of the statement.

evidence_list.snippet: However, as these orders were lifted and more return-to-work policies were adopted, our revenue from delivery solutions declined.

components.reason: Shows negative financial impact directly tied to the unwinding of pandemic restrictions (‘revenue… declined’).
Demonstrates volatility risk inherent in pandemic-driven demand shifts.
Refers to effects in the past tense; impact already realized, not ongoing.

evidence_list.reasoning_summary: Captures the downside that followed the pandemic boom, confirming exposure to demand reversals; moderated for being retrospective.

evidence_list.snippet: Conversely, our rate of traffic growth increased significantly during the onset of the COVID-19 pandemic and the associated stay-at-home orders across the globe.

components.reason: Links pandemic to operational metric (traffic growth) demonstrating sensitivity.
Historical reference; impact has already receded.

evidence_list.reasoning_summary: Shows operational impact but lacks financial quantification and is historical, so score is moderate-low.

evidence_list.snippet: However, as these orders were lifted and more return-to-work policies were adopted, our traffic growth rates declined.

components.reason: States adverse operational impact tied to post-pandemic shift (‘traffic growth rates declined’).
Highlights volatility risk following pandemic measures.
Describes past events rather than current or forecasted risk.

evidence_list.reasoning_summary: Confirms downside exposure but remains historical and unquantified, producing a modest score.

evidence_list.snippet: In addition, pandemics or other public health crises, as well as any derivative disruptions such as those experienced during the COVID-19 pandemic, in places where we operate may adversely affect our results of operations.

components.reason: Forward-looking acknowledgement that future pandemics can harm operations.
Mentions derivative disruptions, broadening risk scope (supply chain, labour, etc.).
Highly generic with no specifics or quantification; partially mitigates severity.

evidence_list.reasoning_summary: Provides a prospective risk statement but lacks detail, so it earns a moderate-low score.
